comment:
* Compat methods for accessing TypedArray values.
 *
 * All the getNamed*() functions added the attribute name match, to take care of potential ID
 * collision between the private attributes in older OS version (OEM) and the attributes existed in
 * the newer OS version.
 * For example, if an private attribute named "abcdefg" in Kitkat has the
 * same id value as "android:pathData" in Lollipop, we need to match the attribute's namefirst.
 *

methods.name: public static boolean hasAttribute(@NonNull XmlPullParser parser, @NonNull String attrName)
methods.comment:
* @return Whether the current node ofthe  {@link XmlPullParser} has an attribute with the
     * specified {@code attrName}.

methods.name: public static float getNamedFloat(@NonNull TypedArray a, @NonNull XmlPullParser parser, @NonNull String attrName, @StyleableRes int resId, float defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves a float attribute value. In addition to the styleable resource ID, we also make
     * sure that the attribute name matches.
     *
     * @return a float value in the {@link TypedArray} with the specified {@code resId}, or
     * {@code defaultValue} if it does not exist.

methods.name: public static boolean getNamedBoolean(@NonNull TypedArray a, @NonNull XmlPullParser parser, @NonNull String attrName, @StyleableRes int resId, boolean defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves a boolean attribute value. In addition to the styleable resource ID, we also make
     * sure that the attribute name matches.
     *
     * @return a boolean value in the {@link TypedArray} with the specified {@code resId}, or
     * {@code defaultValue} if it does not exist.

methods.name: public static int getNamedInt(@NonNull TypedArray a, @NonNull XmlPullParser parser, @NonNull String attrName, @StyleableRes int resId, int defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves an int attribute value. In addition to the styleable resource ID, we also make
     * sure that the attribute name matches.
     *
     * @return an int value in the {@link TypedArray} with the specified {@code resId}, or
     * {@code defaultValue} if it does not exist.

methods.name: public static int getNamedColor(@NonNull TypedArray a, @NonNull XmlPullParser parser, @NonNull String attrName, @StyleableRes int resId, @ColorInt int defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves a color attribute value. In addition to the styleable resource ID, we also make
     * sure that the attribute name matches.
     *
     * @return a color value in the {@link TypedArray} with the specified {@code resId}, or
     * {@code defaultValue} if it does not exist.

methods.name: public static ComplexColorCompat getNamedComplexColor(@NonNull TypedArray a, @NonNull XmlPullParser parser, Resources.@Nullable Theme theme, @NonNull String attrName, @StyleableRes int resId, @ColorInt int defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves a complex color attribute value. In addition to the styleable resource ID, we also
     * make sure that the attribute name matches.
     *
     * @return a complex color value form the {@link TypedArray} with the specified {@code resId},
     * or containing {@code defaultValue} if it does not exist.

methods.name: public static ColorStateList getNamedColorStateList(@NonNull TypedArray a, @NonNull XmlPullParser parser, Resources.@Nullable Theme theme, @NonNull String attrName, @StyleableRes int resId)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves a color state list object. In addition to the styleable resource ID, we also

     *
     * @return a color state list object form the {@link TypedArray} with the specified
     * {@code resId}, or null if it does not exist.

methods.name: private static ColorStateList getNamedColorStateListFromInt(@NonNull TypedValue value)
public static int getNamedResourceId(@NonNull TypedArray a, @NonNull XmlPullParser parser, @NonNull String attrName, @StyleableRes int resId, @AnyRes int defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves a resource ID attribute value. In addition to the styleable resource ID, we also

     *

     * {@code defaultValue} if it does not exist.

methods.name: public static String getNamedString(@NonNull TypedArray a, @NonNull XmlPullParser parser, @NonNull String attrName, @StyleableRes int resId)

methods.name: public static TypedValue peekNamedValue(@NonNull TypedArray a, @NonNull XmlPullParser parser, @NonNull String attrName, int resId)
methods.comment:
* Retrieve the raw TypedValue for the attribute at <var>index</var>
     * and return a temporary object holding its data.  This object is only
     * valid until the next call on to {@link TypedArray}.

methods.name: public static TypedArray obtainAttributes(@NonNull Resources res, Resources.@Nullable Theme theme, @NonNull AttributeSet set, int @NonNull [] attrs)
methods.comment:
* Obtains styled attributes from the theme, if available, or unstyled
     * resources if the theme is null.

methods.name: public static boolean getBoolean(@NonNull TypedArray a, @StyleableRes int index, @StyleableRes int fallbackIndex, boolean defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* @return a boolean value of {@code index}. If it does not exist, a boolean value of
     * {@code fallbackIndex}. If it still does not exist, {@code defaultValue}.

methods.name: public static Drawable getDrawable(@NonNull TypedArray a, @StyleableRes int index, @StyleableRes int fallbackIndex)
methods.comment:
* @return a drawable value of {@code index}. If it does not exist, a drawable value of
     * {@code fallbackIndex}. If it still does not exist, {@code null}.

methods.name: public static int getInt(@NonNull TypedArray a, @StyleableRes int index, @StyleableRes int fallbackIndex, int defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* @return an int value of {@code index}. If it does not exist, an int value of
     * {@code fallbackIndex}. If it still does not exist, {@code defaultValue}.

methods.name: public static int getResourceId(@NonNull TypedArray a, @StyleableRes int index, @StyleableRes int fallbackIndex, @AnyRes int defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* @return a resource ID value of {@code index}. If it does not exist, a resource ID value of
     * {@code fallbackIndex}. If it still does not exist, {@code defaultValue}.

methods.name: public static String getString(@NonNull TypedArray a, @StyleableRes int index, @StyleableRes int fallbackIndex)
methods.comment:
* @return a string value of {@code index}. If it does not exist, a string value of
     * {@code fallbackIndex}. If it still does not exist, {@code null}.

methods.name: public static CharSequence getText(@NonNull TypedArray a, @StyleableRes int index, @StyleableRes int fallbackIndex)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves a text attribute value with the specified fallback ID.
     *
     * @return a text value of {@code index}. If it does not exist, a text value of
     * {@code fallbackIndex}. If it still does not exist, {@code null}.

methods.name: public static CharSequence @Nullable [] getTextArray(@NonNull TypedArray a, @StyleableRes int index, @StyleableRes int fallbackIndex)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves a string array attribute value with the specified fallback ID.
     *
     * @return a string array value of {@code index}. If it does not exist, a string array value
     * of {@code fallbackIndex}. If it still does not exist, {@code null}.

methods.name: public static int getAttr(@NonNull Context context, int attr, int fallbackAttr)
methods.comment:
* @return The resource ID value in the {@code context} specified by {@code attr}. If it does
     * not exist, {@code fallbackAttr}.
